LanguageData.MFS_Intro: Spawns a faction's missing world bases using vanilla settlement generation, on the faction's own world layer.
LanguageData.MFS_BufferTooltip: New bases won't be placed within this many world tiles of any of your settlements. The distance is measured in surface world tiles on every layer, so it also stops orbital platforms from sitting directly above your base. Set to 0 to disable.
LanguageData.MFS_BasesTooltip:
Owned bases / goal.

The goal is not a fixed number. Each world layer has a total settlement budget based on its size and the world's population setting, and that budget is split between the layer's settlement-founding factions in proportion to their settlement generation weight.

Adding a new faction to a layer adds another claimant to the same budget, so the goal for factions already on that layer goes down.
